# Requirements Quality Checklist: Project Creation Gate & Document Staging

**Purpose**: Validate the *requirements writing* for the 2026-09-16 bug-3 amendment — the
per-kind mandatory gate (FR-007b–d, FR-009, FR-009a), the staged-upload mechanism (plan D10,
research §8) and the advisory readiness split (plan D12)
**Created**: 2026-09-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [research.md](../research.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Scope note**: `requirements.md` (spec quality) and `migration.md` (the letter-kind migration) are
separate artifacts and are not duplicated here. This checklist covers only the bug-3 amendment.

## Requirement Completeness — the staging mechanism

- [ ] CHK036 Are requirements defined for what becomes of staged documents when a creation request is refused? [Gap] — FR-009 specifies that no *project* is created and is silent on the staged rows and their blobs
- [ ] CHK037 Is the staged-document retention window specified as a requirement, or only as a plan-level configuration value? [Gap, Plan §D10] — "the configured staging window" names a knob without stating a bound anyone can hold the system to
- [ ] CHK038 Are requirements defined for deleting a staged document's stored bytes, not merely its row? [Gap] — an orphaned blob is invisible to every requirement currently written
- [ ] CHK039 Is it specified whether a staged document may be referenced by more than one creation attempt, or consumed exactly once? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK040 Are requirements defined for the maximum number and total size of documents attachable to one creation request? [Gap] — no bound is stated anywhere, and the request is unauthenticated against a project that does not yet exist
- [ ] CHK041 Is it specified whether **supplementary** documents (no `documentTypeId`) may be staged at creation, or only required kinds? [Gap, Spec §FR-009] — FR-009 addresses mandatory kinds; US2 scenario 5 addresses supplementary uploads only after the project exists
- [ ] CHK042 Are requirements defined for auditing the sweep — is a swept staged document a recorded event or a silent deletion? [Gap]

## Requirement Completeness — authorisation of a pre-project upload

- [ ] CHK043 Is the permission required to **stage** a document specified? [Gap, Plan §D9] — the plan assigns `PROJECTS`, but no requirement states it, and this is the one upload in the feature that cannot be authorised against the project it belongs to because the project does not exist yet
- [ ] CHK044 Are requirements defined preventing one caller from referencing another caller's `stagedDocumentId`? [Gap, Security] — a staged id is a bearer reference to stored bytes with no project-level authorisation available to check it against
- [ ] CHK045 Is company scoping of staged documents specified, including for a cross-company caller naming a company? [Gap, Spec §FR-025] — FR-025 covers "every surface in this feature"; whether staging inherits it is not stated
- [ ] CHK046 Are requirements defined for whether a staged document survives the staging caller losing the permission, or being deactivated, before the creation completes? [Gap, Edge Case]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK047 Does FR-009 specify that missing kinds are named by their human-readable **label** rather than an internal identifier? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009] — plan D11 decides this and gives the reason; the requirement says only "naming every missing mandatory kind"
- [ ] CHK048 Is "documents attached to the creation request" defined precisely enough to distinguish a staged reference from an inline payload? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK049 Is the term "advisory" defined in the requirements themselves, rather than only by contrast with "mandatory"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007b]
- [ ] CHK050 Is it unambiguous whether FR-007d's refusal applies at the moment a kind is marked mandatory, at save time for the whole set, or both? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007d]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK051 Do FR-009 and FR-008 agree on what "outstanding" means for an advisory kind versus a mandatory one? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK052 Is FR-007c's permission consistent with the permission the shipped requirements route actually enforces, after the 2026-09-16 correction? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007c, Plan §D13] — the requirement was amended to `SETTINGS`; confirm no other requirement or contract still says `COMPANY_SETTINGS`
- [ ] CHK053 Does the `isMandatory` column comment in `schema.prisma` still assert the pre-reversal rule, contradicting FR-009? [Conflict, Data-model] — flagged in data-model.md as requiring rewrite; confirm the requirement set does not depend on the stale reading anywhere else
- [ ] CHK054 Are the readiness semantics consistent between FR-008, US2 scenario 1 and plan D12's additive fields? [Consistency, Plan §D12] — US2 scenario 1 requires every required kind listed with its marking, while FR-008's readiness figure counts only the mandatory set

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK055 Is SC-002a's "across every creation path the product offers" measurable — are the creation paths enumerable from the requirements? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002a]
- [ ] CHK056 Can "no project is created" be objectively verified against partial-failure states, or only against the response? [Measurability, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK057 Are acceptance criteria defined for the staging mechanism at all, as distinct from the gate it serves? [Gap, Spec §SC-002a] — SC-002a through SC-002c cover the gate, the settings and project-page visibility; none covers staging
- [ ] CHK058 Is SC-002b's "with no developer involvement" objectively verifiable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002b]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK059 Are requirements defined for a creation that attaches a document of a kind **not** in the required set? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK060 Are requirements defined for a creation attaching two documents of the same mandatory kind? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK061 Are recovery requirements defined for a creation that fails **after** the gate passed — is the caller told their staged documents survived, or must they re-upload? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Gap]
- [ ] CHK062 Are requirements defined for the interaction between the sweep and an in-flight creation — can a staged row be deleted between the gate's check and the attach? [Coverage, Gap] — the plan places both in one transaction; no requirement states the property
- [ ] CHK063 Are requirements defined for the required set changing while a creation is in flight — which set the creation is judged against? [Coverage, Gap, Concurrency]
- [ ] CHK064 Are requirements defined for a document type being deleted while a mandatory requirement references it? [Coverage, Gap] — FR-022 protects letter kinds from exactly this and no equivalent protects document types

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK065 Is the all-advisory configuration (no gate at all) explicitly permitted in the requirements rather than only in the edge-case list? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK066 Are requirements defined for a company with an empty required set — is creation unconditionally permitted? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK067 Is the behaviour specified when every required kind is mandatory and none has a defined document type? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007d] — FR-007d prevents reaching this state going forward; whether an existing company can already be in it is not addressed

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK068 Are requirements defined for the storage cost or growth bound of staged documents that are never consumed? [Gap, NFR]
- [ ] CHK069 Does NFR-002's 3-second retrieval target cover documents listed on the project surface under FR-008a? [Coverage, Spec §NFR-002]
- [ ] CHK070 Are the readiness query's performance guarantees restated or amended for the advisory split? [Consistency, Plan §D12] — research §4's one-query property is asserted in the plan; confirm the requirement set still expresses it

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK071 Is the assumption that the gate is enforced server-side written as a testable requirement, or does it remain only an assumption? [Traceability, Spec §Assumptions] — it is the property SC-002a is measured against, and an assumption is not a requirement
- [ ] CHK072 Is the dependency on `settings.DocumentType` scope (FR-001b) for the requirement editor stated in the requirements rather than only in plan D5? [Traceability, Spec §FR-007a]
- [ ] CHK073 Is the staged-document mechanism's reversibility recorded in the requirements as a deliberate decision, or only in research §8? [Traceability] — the client may yet accept a draft project, which deletes the whole mechanism

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- IDs continue from `migration.md`, whose last item is CHK035, so this file starts at CHK036
- **The densest cluster is authorisation of a pre-project upload (CHK043–CHK046).** Every other
  upload in this feature is authorised against the thing it attaches to. Staging has no such thing,
  and the requirements have not yet said what stands in its place
